Package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.view.freemarker.console

Class Annotations

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.rest.server.view.freemarker.console.Annotations
All Implemented Interfaces:
Decorator
public final class Annotations extends Object implements Decorator
The built-in annotations decorator: ECharts markPoint presets (max, min, average) on every series, or explicit points on a carrier series juneau-annotations-<n>.
Example:

Annotations.max().withMin().label("{name}");

Since:
10.0.0
